data.name: Welcome
data.value: MOM is a community project for Final Fantasy XIV, providing access to shared content through a public access host.

data.name: AccessBoundary
data.value: The public plugin is free. Additional functionality is distributed through privately granted access. Contact the community for availability and support.

data.name: CommunityCredit
data.value: A collaborative community effort by DhogGPT.

data.name: CommunityHelp
data.value: Visit The Dumpster Fire channel on Discord for plugin help and discussion, questions, experiences, and announcements.

data.name: SupportBoundary
data.value: Support helps the project and does not automatically grant access.

data.name: InstallAccess
data.value: Keep this public plugin installed and enabled. In /apm, include mom in the plugin list and trust the publisher. Copy the direct access ZIP link, then click the global Check clipboard for updates button. APM installs the access update and reloads MOM.

data.name: RefreshExplanation
data.value: This checks for and loads your existing access module.

data.name: AccessFailure
data.value: Access could not be activated. Check the Dalamud log or contact the publisher for a compatible update.

data.name: ShellWelcome
data.value: Welcome to MOM. This public plugin provides an introduction and installation guidance. Get the full plugin through Discord and install it with Aethertek Plugin Manager (APM).

data.name: ShellStep1
data.value: 1. Copy the direct full-plugin ZIP URL from Discord (mom.zip or mom-v<version>.zip).

data.name: ShellStep2
data.value: 2. Open /apm and check I trust the publisher.

data.name: ShellStep3
data.value: 3. Select mom in APM's development-plugin list.

data.name: ShellStep4
data.value: 4. Choose Update selected plugin from clipboard.

data.name: ShellFinish
data.value: Keep APM enabled until the update finishes. The full plugin replaces this introduction and opens with /mom.
